dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, can you lend me a hundred baht?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, kən juː ˈlɛnd miː ə ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sure. Here you are. What's it for?
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. ˈhɪr juː ˈɑːr. ˈwʌts ɪt ˈfɔːr?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Stamps. I want to mail my mom some photos.
dialogue.reading: ˈstæmps. aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈmeɪl maɪ ˈmɑːm sʌm ˈfoʊtoʊz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's nice! Oh, did you receive the package from your parents?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈnaɪs! ˈoʊ, dɪd juː rɪˈsiːv ðə ˈpækɪdʒ frəm jʊr ˈpɛrənts?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Not yet. They mailed it two weeks ago.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈjɛt. ðeɪ ˈmeɪld ɪt ˈtuː ˈwiːks əˈɡoʊ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Maybe the post office can deliver it tomorrow.
dialogue.reading: ˈmeɪbi ðə ˈpoʊst ˌɔːfɪs kən dɪˈlɪvər ɪt təˈmɑːroʊ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I hope so! My dad always sends me Canadian chocolate.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈhoʊp ˈsoʊ! maɪ ˈdæd ˈɔːlweɪz ˈsɛndz miː kəˈneɪdiən ˈtʃɔːklət.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Then you can give me some chocolate!
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn juː kən ˈɡɪv miː sʌm ˈtʃɔːklət!
